# About This Site

Welcome to my website. 

This website presents some of my course work. The site was created using RMarkdown and the `render_site()` function, demonstrating how reproducible research and web publishing can be combined in a simple workflow. 

Find the source on [GitHub](https://uta-ke.github.io/rmarkdown-website/).
